text: Meet Maya. She's about to control her Mac — without touching it.

This is Pawvis. It turns the webcam you already have into touch-free hand control — powered by Apple Intelligence, running entirely on your Mac. Nothing you do ever leaves it. And it's completely free, and open source.
Raise an open hand, and the claw cursor rides her palm. Wherever her hand goes, the cursor follows.
Dip an index finger to click — like tapping an invisible mouse. Keep it down, and she can grab a window and drag it anywhere.
Custom gestures fire real actions. Her shaka? That opens her video calls.
Fold two fingers in, and her hand becomes the scroll wheel — the page glides from across the room.
And if Pawvis doesn't know your gesture… teach it. Show it your move a few times — it learns it live, right in the trainer — then bind it to any action you like.
There's plenty more: flick between desktops, snap windows into place, or just talk to it — "Pawvis, open Notes" — understood on-device, step by step.
Pawvis. Your hand is the mouse. Free and open source for macOS — download it at pawvis dot app.
